job.title: Hiring For SAP Hybris Developer
job.email_subject: Application: SAP Hybris Developer – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need an SAP Hybris Developer who knows the platform inside out – I have built on SAP Commerce Cloud for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 / 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell
– OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third parties
– CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, query refactoring that cut response latency

I am used to working with distributed teams across India and Europe and to taking ownership of production quality. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP Hybris Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 / 2211, Java, Spring & OCC APIs
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years building, extending and supporting enterprise B2B and B2C commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, OCC REST APIs for headless storefronts, Promotions Engine, OMS, Impex, Cronjobs and FlexibleSearch, plus PIM / ERP / MDM integrations with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performs code reviews, mentors junior developers and supports production in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: This role is pure SAP Hybris development, which is exactly where my strengths lie: Promotions Engine, OMS, Impex, Cronjobs, FlexibleSearch and OCC APIs on Hybris 2105 and 2211 for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I want to bring that platform depth to a team that delivers demanding commerce projects for its clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am applying for your SAP Hybris Developer role: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, 5+ years on Hybris 2105/2211 at Rockwell Automation and Shell (Java, Spring, OCC APIs, PIM/ERP integration). I would be glad to talk!

en.subject: Application: SAP Hybris Developer
en.hook: You are looking for an SAP Hybris Developer who can deliver on a live enterprise platform from day one. That is my daily work: for more than five years I have built and extended SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell with Java and Spring – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: Core Hybris modules
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: OCC REST & headless
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP web services and customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters.

bullets.label: Data integration
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Code quality & mentoring
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production issues and provided technical guidance to junior developers; engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved system stability and data consistency.
